a.speaker: mom
a.text: Cassie? It's Mom. I know it's late. A man called about Tommy's car. Arlo something. He says he still has it.

b.speaker: mom
b.text: He said you'd come for it tonight. Out in Yermo? At two in the morning?

d.speaker: mom
d.text: Bring me something of his. Anything. ...And be nice to the dogs. You know how you get with dogs.
